For December 2024, the INEI reported a 12-month inflation rate of 1.97% for Lima Metropolitana, with a monthly increase of 0.11%. Several sources confirm these figures:

- **Annual rate:** The INEI's official bulletin gives the December 2024 year-on-year figure as 1.97% (En diciembre 2024, inflación anual de Lima Metropolitana fue 1,97%). The BCRP's study note reports the same 12-month figure.
- **Monthly change:** Prices rose 0.11% in December (acumulando una inflación anual de 1.97%). Food and beverage prices rose only slightly, by 0.06% (Alimentos y Bebidas no Alcohólicas tuvo un ligero aumento (0.06%)).
- **Drivers:** Alcoholic beverages and tobacco contributed most to the monthly rise, at 0.10% (Bebidas Alcohólicas, Tabaco y Estupefacientes (0.10%)). Restaurant menus also pushed prices up (mayores precios en el menú de restaurantes).
- **Core inflation:** Excluding food and energy, prices rose 0.40% in December (los precios sin alimentos y energía se incrementaron en 0,40 %).
- **Full-year 2024:** Lima's annual rate closed the year at 1.97%, with a monthly average of 0.16% (con una tasa promedio mensual de 0,16 %). Nationally, inflation was 1.90%.

The search did not turn up the INEI's own page for the 12-month series, but the INEI bulletin and BCRP note both confirm the 1.97% figure.
